The '''DataSearch Engine 12C-A''', also known as the '''TerexComm Executive''', was a datasearching device manufactured by [[TerexComm]]. It could be used to search [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems for specific information, and could search thousands of [[data screen unit]]s in less than three seconds. General searches, such as "[[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]" yielded thousands of results; specific search strings such as "stormtrooper garrisons in the [[Yartexx quarter]]" would return more accurate results.

Unlike the [[DataSearch Engine 9C]], the 12C-A did not function with the addition of a [[power condenser]]. When the modification was tried, the device often shorted out.
